name: ActionNameAvailable
checks: The action has an actionName.
message: ACN-01: Action '{self.name}' has no 'actionName'. Set it. Without it, the transformation falls back to the element name.
ocl: self.actionName <> null and self.actionName.size() > 0

name: HasEffect
checks: Checks that an action changes something. Mode B (the tag 'precondition' or 'effect' is set): the tag 'effect' is set. Mode A: the action has an output pin typed by a predicate or a function, or an input predicate pin that is neither preserved nor negated, which the negation rule deletes. This includes an action without any precondition or effect. The tag 'cost' alone does not count as an effect, because it changes the plan cost, not the state.
message: ACN-02: Action '{self.name}' has no effect. Applying it changes no predicate and no function.
ocl: if self.precondition <> null or self.effect <> null then self.effect <> null else (self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).output->exists(op | PDDL_Predicate.allInstances()->exists(q | q = op.type) or PDDL_Function.allInstances()->exists(q | q = op.type)) or self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->exists(ip | PDDL_Predicate.allInstances()->exists(q | q = ip.type) and not (PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(pa | pa = ip and pa.isNegated = true) or PDDL_FlowAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(fa | (ip.incoming->includes(fa) or ip.outgoing->includes(fa)) and fa.isNegated = true)) and not (PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(pa | pa = ip and pa.isPreserved = true) or PDDL_FlowAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(fa | (ip.incoming->includes(fa) or ip.outgoing->includes(fa)) and fa.isPreserved = true)))) endif

name: ValidDuration
checks: The duration of a durative action is a positive number.
message: ACN-03: Duration '{self.duration}' is not a positive number. Expected e.g. '5' or '2.5'.
ocl:
self.duration <> null and self.duration.size() > 0 and
self.duration.matches('^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$')

name: UniqueActionNames
checks: Checks that action names are unique, ignoring case, durative actions included. Two actions may share a name only if they call the same behavior.
message: ACN-04: Action name of '{self.name}' is used elsewhere in the model by an action calling a different behavior. The transformation would merge both into one schema.
ocl: self.actionName = null or self.actionName.size() = 0 or PDDL_Action.allInstances()->select(a | a <> self and a.actionName <> null and a.actionName.toLower() = self.actionName.toLower())->forAll(a | a.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).behavior = self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).behavior)

name: ParameterTypesExist
checks: Every input pin of the action is untyped or typed with a PDDL_Type, a PDDL_Predicate or a PDDL_Function. Predicate- and function-typed pins carry the Mode A precondition and effect and are not parameters. Whether a function-typed pin states its role is checked by ACN-10.
message: ACN-05: Action '{self.name}': an input pin is typed with something that is neither a PDDL_Type, a PDDL_Predicate nor a PDDL_Function. The template does not transform such a pin, so parameter binding can fail.
ocl:
self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->forAll(pin |
    pin.type = null or
    PDDL_Type.allInstances()->exists(t | t = pin.type) or
    PDDL_Predicate.allInstances()->exists(p | p = pin.type) or
    PDDL_Function.allInstances()->exists(f | f = pin.type)
)

name: CostMustBeNonNegative
checks: The action cost is not negative.
message: ACN-06: Action '{self.name}' has cost {self.cost}. Action costs must not be negative.
ocl: self.cost <> null implies self.cost >= 0

name: ValidActionName
checks: The action name is a valid PDDL identifier and not a reserved PDDL keyword.
message: ACN-07: Action name '{self.actionName}' is not a valid PDDL identifier or is a reserved PDDL keyword.
ocl:
self.actionName = null or self.actionName.size() = 0 or
(self.actionName.matches('^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$') and Set{'and','or','not','imply','when','forall','exists','either','object','number','define','domain','problem','total-cost','increase','decrease','assign','scale-up','scale-down'}->excludes(self.actionName))

name: DurativeActionNotGenerated
checks: Durative actions (PDDL 2.1 Level 3) can be specified with the profile, but the templates do not generate them.
message: ACN-08: Durative action '{self.name}': PDDL 2.1 Level 3 is supported by the profile but not generated by the templates.
ocl: false

name: ParametersAmbiguous
checks: The tag 'parameters' is not set when typed pins exist. The transformation prefers the pins and uses the tag only for actions without typed pins.
message: ACN-09: Tag 'parameters' is set although typed pins exist. The transformation prefers the pins, so the tag has no effect here. It is only a fallback for actions without typed pins.
ocl:
self.parameters = null or self.parameters.size() = 0 or
self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->forAll(pin | pin.type = null)

name: FunctionPinsAnnotated
checks: In Mode A, every pin typed with a PDDL_Function carries a PDDL_PinAnnotation that states its role: 'comparison' on an input pin (precondition), 'numericEffect' on an output pin (effect). Without it the template cannot transform the pin. Mode B actions (precondition or effect set) are exempt.
message: ACN-10: Action '{self.name}' (Mode A): a pin is typed with a PDDL_Function but does not say what to do with it. Set 'comparison' on an input pin or 'numericEffect' on an output pin (PDDL_PinAnnotation), plus numericValue or numericOperand.
ocl:
self.precondition <> null or self.effect <> null or
(self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->forAll(pin |
    not PDDL_Function.allInstances()->exists(f | f = pin.type) or
    PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = pin and a.comparison <> null)) and
 self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).output->forAll(pin |
    not PDDL_Function.allInstances()->exists(f | f = pin.type) or
    PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = pin and a.numericEffect <> null)))

name: PinAtomsConsistent
checks: Checks the predicate pins of one call for contradicting atoms: an output pin sets an atom that a negated output pin deletes, an input pin preserves an atom that a negated output pin deletes, or the same atom is preserved on one input pin and not on another. An atom is the predicate of the pin together with its tag 'arguments'; pins without 'arguments' count as the same atom. Only pin annotations are read, not object flows. PDDL gives each case a defined meaning (delete before add), but the annotation contradicts itself.
message: ACN-11: Action '{self.name}': its predicate pins contradict each other. The same atom is set and deleted, preserved and deleted, or preserved on one input pin and consumed on another.
ocl:
self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).output->forAll(o1 | self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).output->forAll(o2 |
  (o1 <> o2 and o1.type = o2.type and PDDL_Predicate.allInstances()->exists(p | p = o1.type) and PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->select(a | a = o1)->collect(a | if a.arguments = null then '' else a.arguments->iterate(s; acc : String = '' | acc.concat((if s.substring(1, 1) = '?' then s.substring(2, s.size()) else s endif).toLower()).concat(' ')) endif)->reject(k | k = '') = PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->select(a | a = o2)->collect(a | if a.arguments = null then '' else a.arguments->iterate(s; acc : String = '' | acc.concat((if s.substring(1, 1) = '?' then s.substring(2, s.size()) else s endif).toLower()).concat(' ')) endif)->reject(k | k = '') and PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = o2 and a.isNegated = true)) implies PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = o1 and a.isNegated = true)))
and self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->forAll(i | self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).output->forAll(o |
  (i.type = o.type and PDDL_Predicate.allInstances()->exists(p | p = i.type) and PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->select(a | a = i)->collect(a | if a.arguments = null then '' else a.arguments->iterate(s; acc : String = '' | acc.concat((if s.substring(1, 1) = '?' then s.substring(2, s.size()) else s endif).toLower()).concat(' ')) endif)->reject(k | k = '') = PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->select(a | a = o)->collect(a | if a.arguments = null then '' else a.arguments->iterate(s; acc : String = '' | acc.concat((if s.substring(1, 1) = '?' then s.substring(2, s.size()) else s endif).toLower()).concat(' ')) endif)->reject(k | k = '') and PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = i and a.isPreserved = true)) implies not PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = o and a.isNegated = true)))
and self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->forAll(i1 | self.oclAsType(CallBehaviorAction).input->forAll(i2 |
  (i1 <> i2 and i1.type = i2.type and PDDL_Predicate.allInstances()->exists(p | p = i1.type) and PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->select(a | a = i1)->collect(a | if a.arguments = null then '' else a.arguments->iterate(s; acc : String = '' | acc.concat((if s.substring(1, 1) = '?' then s.substring(2, s.size()) else s endif).toLower()).concat(' ')) endif)->reject(k | k = '') = PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->select(a | a = i2)->collect(a | if a.arguments = null then '' else a.arguments->iterate(s; acc : String = '' | acc.concat((if s.substring(1, 1) = '?' then s.substring(2, s.size()) else s endif).toLower()).concat(' ')) endif)->reject(k | k = '') and not PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = i1 and a.isNegated = true) and not PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = i2 and a.isNegated = true) and PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = i1 and a.isPreserved = true)) implies PDDL_PinAnnotation.allInstances()->exists(a | a = i2 and a.isPreserved = true)))

name: DomainNameAvailable
checks: The domain has a name. PDDL requires named domains.
message: DOM-01: The PDDL domain has no name. Set 'domainName' or name the package.
ocl: (self.domainName <> null and self.domainName.size() > 0) or (self.name <> null and self.name.size() > 0)

name: UniqueDomainName
checks: Checks that domain names are unique across packages, ignoring case.
message: DOM-02: Duplicate domain name '{self.name}' in the model. Domain names must be unique across packages.
ocl: (if self.domainName <> null and self.domainName.size() > 0 then self.domainName else self.name endif) = null or (if self.domainName <> null and self.domainName.size() > 0 then self.domainName else self.name endif).size() = 0 or PDDL_Domain.allInstances()->select(d | d <> self and (if d.domainName <> null and d.domainName.size() > 0 then d.domainName else d.name endif) <> null and (if d.domainName <> null and d.domainName.size() > 0 then d.domainName else d.name endif).toLower() = (if self.domainName <> null and self.domainName.size() > 0 then self.domainName else self.name endif).toLower())->isEmpty()

name: HasAtLeastOneType
checks: The model contains at least one PDDL_Type. The check covers the whole model, because the types may live in a different package than the domain.
message: DOM-03: Domain '{self.name}': the model does not contain any PDDL_Type yet. Objects and action parameters can only be typed once at least one type exists. Types may live in any package.
ocl: PDDL_Type.allInstances()->notEmpty()

name: ValidDomainName
checks: The domain name is a valid PDDL identifier and not a reserved PDDL keyword.
message: DOM-04: Domain name is not a valid PDDL identifier or is a reserved PDDL keyword.
ocl:
((self.domainName <> null and self.domainName.size() > 0) implies
   (self.domainName.matches('^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$') and Set{'and','or','not','imply','when','forall','exists','either','object','number','define','domain','problem','total-cost','increase','decrease','assign','scale-up','scale-down'}->excludes(self.domainName))) and
((self.domainName = null or self.domainName.size() = 0) implies
   (self.name = null or self.name.size() = 0 or
    (self.name.matches('^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$') and Set{'and','or','not','imply','when','forall','exists','either','object','number','define','domain','problem','total-cost','increase','decrease','assign','scale-up','scale-down'}->excludes(self.name))))

name: ValidConstantName
checks: The constant name is a valid PDDL identifier and not a reserved PDDL keyword.
message: DOM-05: Constant name '{self.name}' is not a valid PDDL identifier or is a reserved PDDL keyword.

((self.constantName <> null and self.constantName.size() > 0) implies
   (self.constantName.matches('^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$') and Set{'and','or','not','imply','when','forall','exists','either','object','number','define','domain','problem','total-cost','increase','decrease','assign','scale-up','scale-down'}->excludes(self.constantName))) and
((self.constantName = null or self.constantName.size() = 0) implies
   (self.name = null or self.name.size() = 0 or
    (self.name.matches('^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$') and Set{'and','or','not','imply','when','forall','exists','either','object','number','define','domain','problem','total-cost','increase','decrease','assign','scale-up','scale-down'}->excludes(self.name))))

name: UniqueConstantNames
checks: Checks that constant names are unique and differ from all object names, ignoring case, because constants and objects share one PDDL namespace and planners read names without case.
message: DOM-06: Duplicate constant name '{self.name}': another constant or an object has the same name. PDDL has one flat namespace for constants and objects.
ocl: (if self.constantName <> null and self.constantName.size() > 0 then self.constantName else self.name endif) <> null and PDDL_Constant.allInstances()->select(c | c <> self and (if c.constantName <> null and c.constantName.size() > 0 then c.constantName else c.name endif) <> null and (if c.constantName <> null and c.constantName.size() > 0 then c.constantName else c.name endif).toLower() = (if self.constantName <> null and self.constantName.size() > 0 then self.constantName else self.name endif).toLower())->isEmpty() and PDDL_Object.allInstances()->select(o | (if o.objectName <> null and o.objectName.size() > 0 then o.objectName else o.name endif) <> null and (if o.objectName <> null and o.objectName.size() > 0 then o.objectName else o.name endif).toLower() = (if self.constantName <> null and self.constantName.size() > 0 then self.constantName else self.name endif).toLower())->isEmpty()

name: FlowRoleExclusive
checks: A flow annotation is not both negated and preserved. The two roles contradict each other.
message: FLW-01: Flow annotation is both negated and preserved. These roles contradict each other. Clear one of them.
ocl: not (self.isNegated = true and self.isPreserved = true)

name: PredicateAtomHasPredicate

ocl: self.predicate <> null

name: FunctionAtomHasFunction
checks: A function atom references a function.
message: FMA-02: The function atom references no function. Set 'function'.
ocl: self.function <> null

name: LiteralHasValue
checks: A literal has a numeric value.
message: FMA-03: The literal has no numeric value. Set 'value'.
ocl: self.value <> null

name: PredicateAtomArity
checks: Checks that a predicate atom in a formula (Mode B) has as many 'arguments' as its predicate has parameters.
message: FMA-04: Predicate atom '{self.name}': the number of 'arguments' differs from the arity of the predicate.
ocl: self.predicate = null or (if self.arguments = null then 0 else self.arguments->size() endif) = self.predicate.ownedAttribute->size()

name: FunctionAtomArity
checks: Checks that a function atom in a formula (Mode B) has as many 'arguments' as its function has parameters.
message: FMA-05: Function atom '{self.name}': the number of 'arguments' differs from the arity of the function.
